versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the telegram-formatting skill.
- Provides clear guidelines for using Telegram's actual supported formatting, distinguishing between Standard and Rich messages modes.
- Lists tested formatting options for both HTML and Markdown (OpenClaw Bot API 10.2), noting which are reliably rendered and which are broken or unavailable.
- Emphasizes real-world tests over spec assumptions, with instructions for re-verification based on OpenClaw version.
- Includes best practices to avoid over-formatting and to enhance message clarity for all reply lengths.
